findings: May2024 actual photo: arching slender culms, narrow blades and dangling small spikelets. Background broad shrub leaves are not sedge foliage. Dense basal tuft with fine arching blades needed. Actual remotely hosted photograph was viewed directly, then current1,4,7 pilots and all36 contact-sheet panels inspected. Actual May photo supports fine arching flowering culms above basal strap leaves; revised25–53cm forms now arch outwards rather than standing as straight fans. Green spikelets are a coarse representation, with per-floret detail and triangular stems unresolved. Accepted as coarse stylized spring source, with variants pending user endorsement.
